description: Phase 5 backend + desktop: Rewards System server side and desktop UI (T14a-T17h). Creates Mongoose models Reward and UserPoints, addPoints/deductPoints utilities, full reward CRUD controller+routes, registers routes in index.js, wires points into roulette.controller.js and order.controller.js, then builds the full rewards module in bartender-desktop. Depends on nothing from FEAT-002/003. The mobile FEAT-005 depends on this FEAT's backend routes being in place.
steps: T14a — Create backend/src/models/Reward.js. ES Module. Schema fields: name(String,required,trim), description(String,default:''), image(String,default:''), pointsCost(Number,required,min:1), category(String,enum:['drink','food','experience','discount'],required), product(ObjectId,ref:'Product'), discountPercent(Number,min:0,max:100,default:0), stock(Number,default:-1), active(Boolean,default:true), validFrom(Date), validUntil(Date), redemptions:[{user:{type:ObjectId,ref:'User'},redeemedAt:{type:Date,default:Date.now},orderId:ObjectId}], deleted(Boolean,default:false). Add timestamps:true. export default mongoose.model('Reward', rewardSchema).

T14b — Create backend/src/models/UserPoints.js. ES Module. Schema: user(ObjectId,ref:'User',required,unique), balance(Number,default:0,min:0), totalEarned(Number,default:0), totalRedeemed(Number,default:0), movements:[{type:String,enum:['earn','redeem','expire','adjust'],amount:Number,description:String,ref:mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,refModel:String,createdAt:{type:Date,default:Date.now}}]. Add a pre-save hook: if this.movements.length > 100, this.movements = this.movements.slice(-100). timestamps:true. export default mongoose.model('UserPoints', userPointsSchema).

T14c — Create backend/src/utils/points.js. ES Module. Import UserPoints from '../models/UserPoints.js'. export async function addPoints(userId, amount, description, refId, refModel): use UserPoints.findOneAndUpdate({user:userId},{$inc:{balance:amount,totalEarned:amount},$push:{movements:{$each:[{type:'earn',amount,description,ref:refId,refModel}],$slice:-100}}},{upsert:true,new:true,runValidators:true}). export async function deductPoints(userId, amount, description, refId, refModel): first findOne, check balance>=amount (throw Error if not), then findOneAndUpdate({user:userId},{$inc:{balance:-amount,totalRedeemed:amount},$push:{movements:...}},{new:true}).

T15a — Create backend/src/controllers/reward.controller.js. Import asyncHandler from '../middlewares/asyncHandler.js'. Import {ok,created,badRequest,notFound,forbidden} from '../utils/response.js'. Import Reward from '../models/Reward.js'. Import UserPoints from '../models/UserPoints.js'. Import {deductPoints} from '../utils/points.js'. Seven functions all wrapped in asyncHandler: getPublicRewards (active, not deleted, date valid), getRewards (admin, all), createReward, updateReward, deleteReward (soft set deleted:true active:false), getMyPoints (requires req.user.id, returns UserPoints doc or default zeros), redeemReward (validate stock!=0, check balance>=pointsCost, call deductPoints, push redemption to reward.redemptions, decrement stock if not -1, return {reward, newBalance}).

T15b — Create backend/src/routes/reward.routes.js. Import Router from express. Import protect, authorizeRoles from '../middlewares/auth.middleware.js'. Import all 7 controller functions. const adminOnly = [protect, authorizeRoles('admin','manager')]. Routes: GET /public (public), GET /my-points (protect), POST /redeem/:id (protect), GET / (adminOnly), POST / (adminOnly), PATCH /:id (adminOnly), DELETE /:id (adminOnly).
T15c — Read backend/src/routes/index.js. Add import rewardRoutes from './reward.routes.js' after existing imports. Add router.use('/rewards', rewardRoutes) after the roulette entry.

T16a — Read backend/src/controllers/roulette.controller.js. Add import {addPoints} from '../utils/points.js' at top. Add const RARITY_POINTS = {COMMON:5, RARE:15, EPIC:40, LEGENDARY:100} near the top. In spinRoulette function, after the await createLog(...) call (step 11), add: let pointsEarned=0; if(userId){ pointsEarned = RARITY_POINTS[selected.rarity]??5; await addPoints(userId, pointsEarned, `Ruleta: ${selected.name} [${selected.rarity}]`, selected._id, 'RouletteDrink'); }. Then set payload.meta.pointsEarned = pointsEarned before return ok(res, payload).

T16b — Read backend/src/controllers/order.controller.js (read the full file to find where createOrder completes). After order is saved and emitOrderCreate(order) is called, add the points fire-and-forget: if(order.userId){ const qty = order.items?.length ?? 1; addPoints(order.userId, qty*5, `Pedido #${order._id}`, order._id, 'Order').catch(err => logger.warn('[Points] Error:', err)); }. Import addPoints from '../utils/points.js' at the top of the file.

T17b — Create bartender-desktop/src/modules/rewards/services/rewardService.ts. Import api from '../../../services/api'. Follow exact same safeRequest pattern as rouletteService.ts. BASE='/rewards'. Functions: getRewards():Promise<Reward[]>, getPublicRewards():Promise<Reward[]>, createReward(data:Partial<Reward>):Promise<Reward>, updateReward(id:string,data:Partial<Reward>):Promise<Reward>, deleteReward(id:string):Promise<void>, getMyPoints():Promise<UserPointsSummary>, redeemReward(rewardId:string):Promise<RedeemResult>.

T17c — Create bartender-desktop/src/modules/rewards/hooks/useRewards.ts. useState for rewards:Reward[], loading:boolean, error:string|null. useEffect on mount calls getRewards(). Expose: rewards, loading, error, refetch, createReward (calls service then refetch), updateReward, deleteReward.

T17d — Create bartender-desktop/src/modules/rewards/components/RewardCard.tsx. Card div className='glass-royale rounded-xl p-4 border border-white/8 hover:border-gold/20 transition-all'. Shows name (text-ivory font-semibold), category badge, pointsCost in a span className='text-grad-gold font-bold'. Stock indicator. Active toggle (button with className depending on active state). Edit/Delete buttons. Props: reward:Reward, onEdit:(r:Reward)=>void, onDelete:(id:string)=>void.

T17e — Create bartender-desktop/src/modules/rewards/components/RewardForm.tsx. Controlled form with useState for each field. Fields: name(text input), description(textarea), pointsCost(number input), category(select: drink/food/experience/discount), stock(number,-1=unlimited), validFrom(date), validUntil(date), active(checkbox). Submit button calls onSubmit(formData). Use the same dark input styles seen in other desktop components (bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-ivory). Props: initial?:Partial<Reward>, onSubmit:(data:Partial<Reward>)=>Promise<void>, onCancel:()=>void.

T17f — Create bartender-desktop/src/modules/rewards/components/RedemptionsLog.tsx. Table showing last redemption activity. useEffect loads getRewards(). Columns: Reward name, Points Cost, Total Redeemed (redemptions.length), Active. Style: same table pattern as RouletteLogs.tsx (dark bg, border-white/8 rows, text-muted headers). No real-time socket needed here.

T17g — Create bartender-desktop/src/modules/rewards/pages/RewardsPage.tsx. Two-panel layout (same as RoulettePage.tsx structure — read that file for layout reference). Left panel: RedemptionsLog + stats (total rewards count, active count). Main panel: list of RewardCard + RewardForm (toggle between list and create/edit). Use useRewards hook. Header with title 'Recompensas' and a className='text-grad-gold' accent.

T17h — Read bartender-desktop/src/components/ui/Sidebar.tsx. Add Gift to lucide-react imports. Add REWARDS:'/rewards' to PATHS object. Add {name:'Recompensas', path:PATHS.REWARDS, icon:Gift} to the Sistema section after the Ruleta entry. Read bartender-desktop/src/router/AppRouter.tsx. Import RewardsPage. Add RoleRoute+Route for /rewards inside the DashboardRoutes block, after the roulette route.
acceptance_criteria: Reward.js and UserPoints.js models import without errors
points.js addPoints and deductPoints functions are importable
order.controller.js calls addPoints after order creation
Desktop build succeeds with the new rewards module
Rewards nav item appears in Sidebar Sistema section
cd bartender-desktop && npm run build exits 0
